吵闹声把宝宝吵醒了吗？
快叫你哥哥起床上学吧！
routine: My night routine starts with one story.
我睡前的例行安排，从一个故事开始。
What is your routine on a school day?
上学的日子你都有哪些固定安排？
What a nice routine for every day!
每天都有好习惯，多好啊！
rover: The moon rover looks at rocks.
How far can the rover drive?
探测车最远能开多远呢？
Wow, the rover works all day and night!
哇，探测车从早到晚都在工作！
rowdy: The rowdy kids laughed in the lunchroom.
吵吵闹闹的孩子们在食堂里大笑。
Why are the monkeys so rowdy today?
猴子们今天怎么这么闹腾？
Don't be rowdy in the library!
rudder: The rudder helps the boat turn.
Where is the rudder on the plane?
Turn the rudder to the left!
ruffian: The ruffian in the story wants all the toys.
故事里的恶棍想要所有的玩具。
Will the ruffian say sorry to the kids?
那个恶棍会向孩子们道歉吗？
Don't be a ruffian, be nice!
ruined: 这场雨毁了我们的野餐。
Was the sand house ruined by the big wave?
沙子房子被大浪毁掉了吗？
Oh no, my drawing is ruined!
ruling: The ruling was no candy today.
裁决说了，今天不许吃糖。
Did the kids like Mother's ruling?
孩子们喜欢妈妈的裁决吗？
The ruling made my brother cry!
这个裁决害得我弟弟哭了！
rumble: I feel the rumble of a big truck.
我感觉到一辆大卡车驶过的隆隆声。
Was that rumble the old train?
那阵轰隆声是老火车发出来的吗？
What a big rumble from the sky!
天上传来好大的轰隆声！
rumbling: My belly is rumbling for lunch.
到午饭点儿了，我的肚子咕咕直叫。
Is that rumbling from the subway?
那轰隆隆的声音是地铁发出来的吗？
I hear a rumbling in the sky!
我听见天上有隆隆的响声！
rummage: I will rummage in my toy box.
我要去玩具箱里翻一翻。
Why do you rummage in the closet?
你为什么在衣柜里翻来翻去？
Let's rummage for my old kite!
我们翻一翻，找找我的旧风筝吧！
rumor: A rumor is not nice to tell.
那个谣言是你传出去的吗？
Don't tell a rumor about your friend!
别讲关于朋友的谣言哦！
runnel: A little runnel runs down the big rock.
一条小细流顺着大石头流下来。
Can you see the runnel in the field?
你能看见田里的那条小水沟吗？
听，那条小溪流在唱歌呢！
rural: The rural school is small but nice.
乡下的学校虽小却很温馨。
Is your home rural or in the city?
你家在乡下还是在城里？
I love the rural sky at night!
rustler: The rustler wants the farmer's cows.
偷牛贼惦记着农场主的牛。
Yay, the rustler will never come back!
耶，偷牛贼再也不敢来啦！
ruthless: The ruthless robot in the story has no friends.
故事里那个冷酷的机器人没有朋友。
Why is that robot so ruthless to the toys?
那个机器人为什么对玩具那么冷酷？
Don't be ruthless with your friends!
sacred: In the story, the old tree was sacred.
在故事里，那棵老树是神圣的。
Why is the old river sacred to them?
他们为什么把那条老河看得那么神圣？
Wow, the sacred song is so nice!
哇，这首神圣的歌真好听！
sacrifice: In a sacrifice, you give up what you love.
牺牲就是舍下你最爱的东西。
What sacrifice did the old bear make?
What a big sacrifice mothers make!
妈妈们的牺牲有多大呀！
safari: We saw lions on our safari.
我们在游猎途中看到了狮子。
Did you use your camera on the safari?
游猎的时候你用相机了吗？
What a fun safari in the tall grass!
高草丛里的游猎之旅真好玩！
saga: Grandfather reads us a saga every night.
爷爷每天晚上给我们读一段传奇故事。
Is this saga about two friends?
这个传奇故事是讲两个朋友的吗？
I love the saga of the little boat!
我喜欢那条小船的传奇！
sagacious: The sagacious old owl watches the forest.
睿智的老猫头鹰静静守望着森林。
Who is the sagacious one in your family?
How sagacious you are, little one!
salaam: He said salaam to his old friend.
他向老朋友问了一声安。
Did she say salaam to your grandmother?
Say salaam when you see your friend.
salary: Father uses his salary to buy our food.
爸爸用工资给全家买吃的。
When does Mother get her salary?
Wow, his salary can buy a new bike!
哇，他的工资能买一辆新自行车！
